pk_400mg_steady_state.source: Sacher et al. NEJM 2023 (doi:10.1056/NEJMoa2303810) as reported by OncLive and search summaries; accumulation from Desai et al. Nat Med 2024 (divarasib + cetuximab). Primary PDF not read.

orr_nejm_2023.derivation: lower = all minus 400 mg; counts back-calculated from reported percentages (53.4% of 58, 56.4% of 39, 29.1% of 55, 35.9% of 39)

lower_dose_mix_assumed.source: NSCLC enrolment by dose in long-term follow-up (Single-Agent Divarasib ... Long-Term Follow-Up of a Phase I Study, 2025, PMC12527784): 400 n=44, 200 n=10, 100 n=5, 50 n=6; mix assumed equal for CRC

safety_pooled.note: pooled across doses, mostly 400 mg; not available by dose

assumptions: dose-proportional PK 50-400 mg (not verified from primary source)
one-compartment first-order absorption; CL/F from AUC_ss at 400 mg
between-subject CV of CL/F = SD/mean of AUC_ss (34.6%)
